LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Shade_Tip: A patch of mirror light counts as full sun: it is hot there (vanilla heatstroke), pawns that avoid the sun path around it, and animals that hide in shade move elsewhere. Off: mirrors change nothing about shade or heat.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Glow_Tip: Where the sky is dim (dusk, or a sun that never climbs), a patch of mirror light counts as brighter for plant growth, sowing and working. In full daylight it changes nothing. Off: mirrors never change how bright a cell is.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Sweep: Static mirrors drift as the sun moves
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Sweep_Tip: On: a mirror that does not track the sun keeps its angle, so when the sun moves across the sky its patch of light slowly drifts off the target, and only a powered heliostat holds a target all day. Off: every mirror holds its target as if the sun stood still. Where the sun never moves, this makes no difference.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Reflectivity_Tip: Multiplies how much light every mirror passes on.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Chain_Tip: A mirror standing in shadow can pass on the light of another mirror aimed at it. This is how many mirrors one beam may pass through. Each mirror loses some of the light.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Render_Tip: How mirror light is drawn on the map. It changes only the picture, never what the light does.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Render_Beam: warm patch and a faint beam
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Blind_Tip: Hostile people standing in a strong patch of mirror light slowly go glare-blind (worse sight), unless goggles or a gene protect their eyes. It wears off in shade. Off: mirror light never dazzles anyone.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_BlindRate: Dazzle speed: {0} per day in full light
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Furnace: Solar furnace works under focused light
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Furnace_Tip: The solar furnace smelts with no fuel and no power while two or more mirrors focus on it. Off: the furnace never works.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_ReAim: Time to turn a mirror by hand: {0}
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Interval_Tip: How often mirror light is worked out again when nothing has changed. Building, aiming or losing power updates it at once. Lower is smoother, higher is cheaper.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_AimAt_DescInstant: Choose the cell this mirror throws its light onto. While it has power it turns at once and follows the sun to hold that cell.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_AimAt_DescJob: Choose the cell this mirror throws its light onto. A colonist (Construction) walks over and turns it.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_ClearAim_Desc: Turn this mirror away so it throws no light.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Preview_Eff: Reflects {0} of the light it gets
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Inspect_Frozen: No power: stopped where it is
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Inspect_Dark: Throws no light: it stands in shadow, or there is no sun
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Inspect_Light: Delivers {0} light ({1} of what it gets, {2})
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Inspect_PartBlocked: Part of the patch is blocked: {0}
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Furnace_Idle: Too little focused light to work
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Dazzle_Tip: Hostile people standing in a strong patch of mirror light shoot less accurately, unless goggles or a gene protect their eyes. Off: mirror light never affects anyone's aim.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Concentration_Ti: Where several mirrors overlap, the light is stronger than plain sun, and anyone standing in it feels hotter (the same sun heat as always, never past the biome's limit). Off: overlapping mirrors feel no hotter than one.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_ConcentrationCap: Light counted at most: {0} times the sun
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_RoomHeat_Tip: Mirror light that reaches inside an enclosed room (through a glazed aperture, or onto a solar furnace indoors) warms the room, like a heater. Outdoors it never changes the air temperature. Off: mirror light never heats a room.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Helio_Tip: By day, a colonist at a signal mirror standing in the sun can flash a friendly settlement within reach and open talks with it, as from a comms console. Reach shrinks as the light fades. Off: no heliograph.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_HelioRange: Heliograph reach in full daylight: {0} world tiles
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Fields: Ancient mirror fields where the biome has them (affects map generation)
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Fields_Tip: Maps of a biome that asks for one (the Long Shade) get a field of seized ancient heliostats and a sealed vault that opens when every sun-stone before it is lit. Every field is checked to be solvable before it is placed. Only affects maps made after the change. Off: no fields are generated.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_PuzzleReAims_Tip: The fewest mirror turns that can solve a new field. More turns is a harder puzzle. Only affects maps made after the change.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_PuzzleMirrors_Ti: How many ancient heliostats a new field has. Each turns between three brass pins. Only affects maps made after the change.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Dust_Tip: Sand, grit and ash storms dull mirrors standing in the open until a colonist cleans them (Cleaning work). Off: mirrors never get dirty.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Setting_Power_Tip: Power a heliostat draws while it follows the sun.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Repair_Desc: Have a colonist (Construction) free this ancient mirror's seized bearings, using one component. Until then it cannot be turned.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Detent_Desc: Have a colonist turn this mirror to brass pin {0} (at {1}). Select the mirror to see where every pin sends its light.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Detent_Pending: A colonist is already due to turn it here.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Inspect_Seized: Seized: its bearings must be freed before it can turn
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Helio_Off: heliographs are off in Mod Settings
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_VaultOpen_Text: Every sun-stone before the ancient vault is lit, and its seal has given way. Whatever the vanished people kept inside is there to take.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Hint_Dark: The stone at {0} is still dark; one of the ancient mirrors has a pin on it.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Hint_DarkRelay: The stone at {0} is still dark, and no mirror has a pin on it: its light must come by way of another mirror.
LanguageData.RM_SolarMirrors_Hint_Next: Try turning the ancient mirror at {0} to pin {1}.
